title.official: ASEAN Guide on AI Governance and Ethics

relevance.reason: A regional voluntary guide for organisations and governments in Southeast Asia on designing, developing and deploying AI responsibly. It is the principal ASEAN AI governance instrument and is expressly non-binding.
ai_provisions: Whole guide — guiding principles, risk assessment, governance components and national/regional recommendations
relevance.excluded_scope: Voluntary guidance; no legal obligation, market-access rule or enforcement.

dates.notes: Launched at the 4th ASEAN Digital Ministers' Meeting on 2 February 2024; the PDF itself carries a December 2023 version date.

status_note: Adopted/launched as a voluntary guide. Non-binding.

languages.note: ASEAN working language is English; only the English guide was consulted.

sources.note: Official PDF of the Guide; states that adoption is voluntary and that it is a living document.

rights.note: Official ASEAN publication; no open licence identified. Metadata only in this corpus.

checks.check: Voluntary nature checked in the Guide's own text.
checks.result: Adoption is voluntary; practical guide and living document.

checks.check: Publisher, year and scope checked on the ASEAN publication page and PDF.
checks.result: ASEAN Secretariat, 2024; commercial and non-military/dual-use AI applications.

verification.notes: Metadata verified; full text not stored.

related.note: The Guide draws on internationally recognised AI principles, including the OECD AI Principles.

gaps: Implementation by ASEAN Member States is not assessed.
Covers commercial and non-military/dual-use applications; military AI is outside its scope.

provenance.discovered_via: ASEAN Secretariat publication page and PDF.
